notes: Single primary FX model entrypoint. Defaults are wired into main.py so calibration work has one canonical runtime target.
session_scope: Normal and stress sessions with event windows; no full Asia/London/New York intraday decomposition yet.
calibration_sources: CME Group, Strengthening FX Primary Liquidity on EBS (2024)
CME Group, Building a Healthy FX Marketplace (2023)
CME Group 2024 annual report, EBS Spot ADNV

calibration_notes.price_vol_scale: The volatility of the latent price per tick, as a multiple of the stress index. It was never calibrated and sat at a constructor default of 0.35, which put 35 basis points of price movement into every tick. Against a quoted spread of two basis points that is not a coherent market, and it was the reason the endogenous provider wound the pool down before the shock it exists to absorb. The value now maps one tick to one second of EUR/USD at six per cent a year, the realised figure for 2026, which sits inside the five to ten per cent range of a calm year. Stress raises the index fivefold and carries the price to thirty per cent.
calibration_notes.mm_alpha1: The coefficient multiplies price volatility per tick expressed in basis points, not the dimensionless stress index. The old value 320 belonged to the old units and cannot be interpreted in the current equation. The current value 0.5 leaves the EBS top-spread gate to the observable touch parameters and gives volatility a small, dimensionally explicit widening role; it is not presented as a separately identified structural estimate.
calibration_notes.amm_lp_rule: The liquidity rule is stated as a dimensionless change, dL/L = phi1 times the fee return over the period, less phi2 times the variance of the price over the period, less phi3 times the cost of the capital over the period. The earlier form added a fee in quote units to a stress index and divided by a liquidity measure whose units differ between the two pool types, so restating the same market with a price of a hundred rather than one changed the constant product response by a factor of twenty six and reversed its sign. phi2 is the curvature of the rebalancing loss, one eighth of the variance for a constant product pool after Milionis, Moallemi, Roughgarden and Zhang, and larger on an amplified curve because it rebalances more for the same price move.
calibration_notes.amm_lp_participation: The primary runtime uses an endogenous provider population with a complete two-asset ledger and an outside option equal to funding_rate_scale, about 2.9 percent annualised at one-second ticks over 252 full trading days. No direct FX-AMM evidence identifies the EWMA speed, capital-adjustment speed, entry margin, entry patience or exit patience. The values alpha=0.02 and 290 observations are therefore a disclosed central design, not EBS calibration and not an estimate of AMM-LP behaviour; in particular the 290-second bank-order lifetime is not used as evidence about capital review. The adjustment cap 1-0.5^(1/290)=0.0023873 gives the central design a 290-second mechanical half-life under a continuously binding resize signal. These behavioural inputs are accepted only through a frozen joint sensitivity design and separate mechanism-identification controls. Warm-up blocks participation decisions until the return estimate has accumulated three EWMA horizons. The entry hurdle is measured relative to the provider's outside option and is separate from the numerical response scale used for position sizing. The zero-subsidy, zero-rebate primary run is a private-sustainability test: closure or no entry is an economic result, not a simulation failure. Funded arms debit an explicit sponsor account through a posted return and/or a loss rebate.
calibration_notes.routing_prior: amm_share_pct is a historical API name. Under the primary liquidity_aware rule it is a weak AMM prior, not a target executed share and not an EBS-calibrated moment. The prior can receive at most routing_prior_mix_cap=0.18 weight before cost, depth, alignment and venue-state scores. The cost-gap scale, prior cap, basis scale and depth normalizers are explicit design parameters and must be swept because they affect routed customer volume, AMM fee income and LP survival. Under fixed_share only, amm_share_pct again becomes a literal routing probability.
calibration_notes.funding_rate_scale: The cost of committed capital as a rate per tick, about three per cent a year across the two currencies of the pair at one second to the tick. The stress index funding_cost keeps its own role and scales this rate, but it is not a rate itself and could not be added to one.
calibration_notes.amm_lp_phi2_hfmm: Removed as a free parameter. The loss curvature of the amplified curve is not a choice, it follows from the curve. Walking the pool to a nearby price and comparing the result against holding the reserves gives one eighth plus a quarter of the amplification, exact to four decimal places from an amplification of one to forty, and the same measurement returns exactly one eighth on the constant product curve, which is the frictionless value in Milionis, Moallemi, Roughgarden and Zhang. At the calibrated amplification of eighteen the coefficient is 4.625. The earlier value of 2.25 was assumed and understated the loss by more than half.
calibration_notes.enable_cpmm: The constant product pool is no longer a co-resident venue of the market. Its curvature is wrong for a pair that trades in a narrow band, which is the reason the amplified curve exists, and in the calibrated configuration it carried a small share of the flow and a small share of the provider result. Holding two facilities at once also made the committed capital of the facility an awkward object to state, since the resource matched comparison needs one number for it. The pool is retained in two roles. It anchors the measurement of the rebalancing curvature, where reproducing the frictionless one eighth exactly is what makes the measured 1/8 + A/4 credible, and it is the unamplified arm of the resource matched comparison, run one pool at a time so that the two curves do not compete for the same flow. Set enable_cpmm to 1 to restore the earlier two pool market.
calibration_notes.spread_block_ebs: The quoted spread is anchored to the primary interdealer venue, which for EUR/USD is EBS, where CME reports an average top-of-book spread of 0.63 pips, about 0.57 bps at a rate near 1.10. The gate now evaluates the model mean, matching the published statistic. The median sits on one model tick and is retained only as a price-grid diagnostic with zero weight. The tolerance on the mean is deliberately wide because the venue figure averages the whole trading day while the model has no intraday session cycle. The grid of half a basis point is a modelling choice and not a quotation from a source; CME also reports material volume on quarter- and three-quarter-pip increments, so the model remains coarser than part of the live venue. fast_lp_base_spread_bps sets the touch while mm_alpha0_base sets the dealer floor. Before 08.08.2026 neither moved the realised touch because a hard 0.01-price-unit half-spread floor pinned the market at 2.00 bps.
calibration_notes.flow_persistence_after_ebs_spread: The ordinary taker classes retain heterogeneous private sign persistence and also respond weakly to the last observed common CLOB imbalance. With common_flow_response=0.30, the eight-seed median lag-one signed-flow autocorrelation is about 0.072 and the median run length about 2.19. This low-confidence order-flow block is diagnostic rather than a publication gate because the cited EBS study establishes serial dependence but does not identify these simulator transition probabilities.
calibration_notes.background_book_size: The anonymous scaffold has been reduced from one thousand orders to ten and is capped at two per cent of near-mid support. It exists only to keep the numerical domain defined outside agent quotes. Every anonymous fill now settles against an explicit background-liquidity account in base and quote, so the layer no longer creates or destroys either asset. Agent-owned orders are never moved by book rebuilding, and each provider owns cancellation and replenishment of its own quotes.
calibration_notes.mm_inventory_half_life: The dealer shifts its quoted mid against its own position, and the size of that shift sets how fast the position mean reverts. At the previous value of 0.3 basis points per unit the half life of the dealer's inventory was six seconds and the median absolute position was one unit against a soft limit of a hundred, so the dealer never carried risk. Bjonnes and Rime report median inventory half lives for foreign exchange dealers ranging from under one minute to fifteen, and Lyons is the original single dealer study of the same quantity, so the model was between ten and a hundred and fifty times too fast. At 0.01 the measured half life is sixty five seconds, which sits inside that range at its lower edge, and the median position is seven per cent of the limit with excursions to half of it. The half life does not lengthen further below this value because the balance sheet controls and the mean reversion of the flow itself also flatten the position, so sixty five seconds is where this lever saturates. The consequence that matters is that the dealer now carries a position into a shock and loses on it: the loss component of the withdrawal score in the crisis window rises four fold.
calibration_notes.mm_quote_life: The bank and non-bank lifecycles are separate measured observables. ECB FXCG material hosted by the ECB reports median EBS order lifetimes of 290 seconds for banks and 2.95 seconds for non-banks. One model tick is one second. The 290- and 3-second inputs parameterise independent per-order geometric cancellation clocks; they are distributional medians, not deterministic caps and not accepted merely because they equal the source. Fills, stale-price amendments and withdrawals also end orders. Acceptance uses Kaplan-Meier medians with live end-of-window orders treated as right-censored, alongside completed-only diagnostics and structural gates against point masses, synchronized cancellations and unknown termination reasons. In the eight-seed development pilot the aggregate bank median was 276.5 seconds (seed range 257-290) and the non-bank median was 3 seconds; a fully matured seed-42 cohort matched its t=999 bank Kaplan-Meier estimate within 0.5 seconds.
calibration_notes.mm_withdrawal_score: Dealer withdrawal is endogenous to information available to that dealer: inventory relative to its soft limit, rolling mark-to-market loss relative to initial capital, observed CLOB order-flow imbalance, current book liquidity, price volatility and funding. AMM support remains a quote-interaction diagnostic and is not an additive exit term: its earlier positive loading saturated in calm markets and faded under stress, so it acted as a calm-only intercept rather than a dealer balance-sheet loss. The score contains no shock-window flag, liquidity-shock dummy or preset name. Full exit requires two consecutive above-threshold observations; the first makes the dealer defensive immediately. The dealer-crisis preset explicitly sets force_mm_pause=false. Heterogeneous thresholds 0.7, 1.0, 1.3, 1.6 and 1.9 generate staggered partial exit. Because no external study identifies a numerical dealer-exit share for this episode, the 0.30 share remains a zero-weight diagnostic; the publication gate is qualitative and multi-seed rather than circularly fitted to that number.

manifest_notes.accepted_error_bands: This section mirrors observables that remain active in primary_model_targets.json, including diagnostics. recovery_half_life_ticks and cross_venue_basis_bps were removed when their targets were withdrawn. A test asserts that the two files cannot drift apart again.
